programme.title: On Angel Wings
programme.desc: One starry night, a shepherd boy is taken on a secret, magical night-flight to witness a Christmas miracle. Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown

It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Dragonfly Bride
programme.desc: Bride Regina lost a child and wants a dragonfly-themed wedding as a symbol of hope. David Tutera has his work cut out for him, having to convince the bride that she deserves every part of the gorgeous garden wedding he's creating. The wedding dress Regina bought on sale is already frayed, and the bridesmaid's dresses are all different shades of green -- David's least favorite color for fashion. What's more, Regina and her fiancé are planning a backyard wedding with no food for the guests! David has one surprise after another for this sweet-natured bride, culminating in an emotional fairy-tale wedding with larger-than-life entertainment.

programme.title: Hollywood Glam Bride
programme.desc: Bride Benita is an actress that wants a Hollywood glam wedding, but she's procrastinated on all the details. Her decorations are better suited to a child's birthday party, and the bridesmaids' dresses remind wedding planner David Tutera of a tube sock! He sees none of the Old Hollywood glitz and glam Benita and her actor fiancé Arlen say they want. David decides to take his bride and groom back in time, trying on wedding fashions from the forties, fifties, and sixties. Can he pull together a swinging, classy affair in time for this bride and groom to say I do?

programme.title: Dope Spoons & Second Honeymoons
programme.desc: Tracie explodes when Clint's secret is revealed. Scott's proposal takes a turn when Lizzie makes a shocking accusation.

programme.title: Close Calls

programme.title: The Schemiest Scheme Ever
programme.desc: Sarah faces Michael & things go left when Michael makes a shocking claim. Scott's surprising confession stuns Lizzie.

programme.title: Skeletons in the Closet
programme.desc: Andrea's shocking secret stuns her friends. Michael surprises Megan and gets grilled on his infidelity. Lacey receives startling texts from John. Angela makes a surprising discovery.

programme.title: Little People, Big Day
programme.desc: Mark Trombino and Carol Skladany, both of whom are described as “a little couple,” have faced unique challenges due to their height. Mark, who stands at 3 feet 3 inches tall, has adapted to the world around him by using extended pedals in his car, a booster seat, and seeking assistance at gas stations. Carol, at 3 feet 11 inches, had never had a serious boyfriend until age 41 and had given up on her lifelong dream of marriage and motherhood. Despite their individual struggles, they found love with each other, and their journey is documented in the context of preparing for their big day.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners
programme.desc: On an episode of “The Wedding Planners,” two different planners work with brides in different locations to plan their special weddings. Melissa Barrad in Southern California assists Rosie and Nandi in planning their wedding at a golf course overlooking the Pacific Ocean. They focus on details like choosing the best location for sunset photos and selecting floral arrangements. Tammy Cowart, on the opposite coast in Orlando, Florida, deals with Jill and Jack. She faces challenges such as hurricane force winds on the wedding day and a venue that requires significant improvements.

programme.title: Sin City Weddings
programme.desc: Las Vegas, known for its neon-lit allure, attracts over 100,000 couples annually who choose to tie the knot in this vibrant city. Whether eloping or planning a destination wedding, Las Vegas offers a range of options. Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. And for a truly iconic experience, they can even get married by the legendary Elvis Presley himself. From bustling marriage bureaus to gilded chapels, Las Vegas provides a unique and unforgettable wedding experience.

programme.title: Bling on the Bride
programme.desc: We are introduced to four planners from Austin, Texas, who collaborate to infuse their unique Texas style into every wedding they organize. Additionally, a planner from Southern California is passionate about creating dream weddings. Austin Planners:Kathie, Vivian, Jeff, and Kiley aim to transform a lakeside yacht club in Texas into a Moroccan beach resort for their couple, Lynsey and Seth. Since the bride and groom reside in Los Angeles, the planners must make decisions on color palettes, floral arrangements, and lounge furniture without direct input. Just hours before the wedding day, a hailstorm unexpectedly hits the lakeside location, adding to the challenges. Southern California Planner (Melissa Barrad): Melissa organizes an elegant wedding at a historical site in San Diego for her couple, Will and Kasey. Her primary concern is transitioning the formal ceremony setting into Kasey's envisioned reception ballroom within a tight timeframe. Despite the unusually chilly California night, the guests patiently await the celebration.

programme.title: April in Paris Bride
programme.desc: Wedding cake is important to every bride. But wedding planner David Tutera knows it has a deeper meaning to bride Kristina, who has struggled with an eating disorder. Kristina's fiancé wouldn't marry her until she was able to eat and enjoy the cake at their wedding. Now that Kristina is healthy, it's time to plan her April in Paris wedding. Trouble is, Kristina has everything from the Eiffel Tower to French poodles thrown into the mix! The bridesmaids chose their own dresses, and the reception venue is a hot tub resort an hour away. David creates a flower-filled fantasy of Parisian art and entertainment. Let them eat cake!

programme.title: Hawaiian Luau Bride
programme.desc: Bride Kristin went from a size 24 to a size 6 after having a stroke. Her fiancé stayed by her side through it all, and even lost 50 pounds himself! Now, Kristin wants her wedding to feel like she's at a Hawaiian luau. But her theme has become as tacky as a tiki torch. The flowers are fake, the bridesmaids are barefoot, and her backyard venue is hardly Hawaiian. Wedding planner David Tutera decides to show off his bride's new figure and her sweet nature, too. With fabulous fashion, flowers, and fire dancers David turns this bride's wedding into a real tropical dream.

programme.title: Shabby Chic Bride
programme.desc: Bride Candice Marie loves shabby chic. Her wedding theme has plenty of white, sparkle, and homey touches. Her thoughtful fiancé even made a shabby chic chandelier to hang over the sweetheart table. But most important of all to Candice Marie is the picture of her mother she wants to carry in her bridal bouquet. David Tutera discovers the shocking news that his bride's mom was murdered when Candice Marie was only four years old. This wedding is all about family and love. Candice Marie puts her trust in David, who gets busy transforming shabby chic into Candice chic! Gorgeous bridal fashion, a bridesmaid surprise and a wild ride in the mountains make this a real wedding journey.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.desc: Troy is one of the world's most iconic destinations. The ancient city in Turkey was the setting for the Iliad, the epic poem that tells the story of the final year of the Trojan War. The spotlight has been back on Troy this year with the release "The Odyssey", the much-acclaimed film that charts Odysseus' journey home after the Trojan War. We travel to present-day Canakkale, where Troy was located, to try to unravel fact from fiction, as well as discovering what the area has to offer out of peak season.

programme.title: Hydref Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Mae Iolo ar dir gwyllt trefol a pharciau, gyda gloÿnnod byw a gweision neidr yn hedfan am y tro olaf, a sgrech y coed yn claddu mes. This time: rutting deer, noisy jackdaws & little egrets.

programme.title: Y Deis
programme.desc: Cwis llawn gwybodaeth, strategaeth a bach o lwc! Yn cystadlu am y Jacpot mae timau o Gaerdydd, Llangefni a Phontypridd. Quiz that combines knowledge, strategy and luck!

programme.title: Cegin Clwyd Bryn Williams
programme.desc: Mae Bryn yn creu panna cotta mafon, ac yn galw heibio menter cadw moch Huw, fferm Pentrefelin. Bryn makes a raspberry panna cotta and calls by a new pig project run by Huw.

programme.title: Cerys Matthews a'r Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Bydd Cerys Matthews yn mynd ar drywydd dwy o ganeuon gwerin mwyaf adnabyddus Cymru - Dafydd y Garreg Wen, ac Y Mochyn Du. Cerys Matthews traces the history of two more Welsh folk songs.

programme.title: Cerys Matthews: Y Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Bydd Cerys yn troi ei sylw at Bachgen Bach o Dincar, cyn teithio i Gaernarfon i ddysgu am Llwyn Onn. Cerys Matthews looks into the history of the songs Bachgen Bach o Dincar and Llwyn Onn.

programme.title: Y Fets
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd. Tro hwn: trio achub coes ci defaid un o chwaraewyr rygbi Cymru, a thrin buwch a mul styfnig ar ffermydd lleol. New series. Terry the ferret and other animals need treatment.

programme.title: Stori'r Iaith - Cerys Matthews
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd. Cerys Matthews sy'n mynd ar daith bersonol i olrhain stori'r iaith Gymraeg. A new series. Cerys Matthews goes on a personal journey exploring the story of the Welsh language.

programme.title: Llond Bol o Japan
programme.desc: Mae Chris Flamebaster Roberts yn Japan lle mae'n cwrdd â meistr swshi ac yn ymweld â marchnad byd enwog Nishiki yn Kyoto. Chris Flamebaster is in Japan, ready to set his tastebuds ablaze!

programme.title: Trefi Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Mae Iolo'n gweld llwynogod, moch daear a dyfrgwn yn crwydro yn y nos. Iolo sees foxes, badgers and otters roaming in the night and visits Wrexham, Haverfordwest, Carmarthen and Pembroke.

programme.title: Cyfrinachau'r Great Escape
programme.desc: Stori peilot o'r Ail Ryfel Byd sy'n datgelu gwybodaeth newydd am y ffilm 'The Great Escape'. The story of a pilot from WWII, which reveals new information about the film 'The Great Escape'.

programme.title: Ffermio
programme.desc: Pwysigrwydd cymorth cyntaf i ffermwyr a dau frawd sydd wedi dod i'r brig gyda'u buches godro. The importance of first aid for farmers and two brothers who have won with their dairy herd.

programme.title: New: Pobol y Cwm Omnibws
programme.desc: Cipolwg yn ôl dros ddigwyddiadau'r wythnos yng Nghwmderi. Omnibus edition looking back at the events in Cwmderi over the past week. With on-screen English subtitles.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C
programme.desc: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd. S4C News and Weather.

programme.title: New: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol
programme.desc: Lowri Morgan sy'n Nheml Shree Swaminarayan Caerdydd yn profi llawenydd Gwyl Diwali. Lowri Morgan's in Shree Swaminarayan Temple Cardiff experiencing the joy of Diwali Festival.

programme.title: New: Cyrraedd Cymru
programme.desc: Seren sy'n olrhain hanesion pobl Asiaidd yng Nghymru, o feddygon i ffoaduriaid, a'u hetifeddiaeth. Seren explores Asian stories in Wales, from doctors to refugees, and their lasting legacy.

programme.title: Glyndwr: Gobaith a Gwaed
programme.desc: Drama-ddogfen emosiynol am Glyndwr, o frwydro Coron Lloegr i'w ddiflaniad dirgel. Emotional docudrama about Glyndwr, from his rebellion against the English to his mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Prosiect Pum Mil
programme.desc: Mae'r criw yn nhref Rhydaman yr wythnos hon i helpu cangen Derwen Newydd o elusen y Wallich. The gang are in Ammanford this week to help the Derwen Newydd branch of the Wallich charity.

programme.title: Y Ci Perffaith
programme.desc: Y tro ma, mae'r teulu Evans yn cael cwmni dau gi - un bach ac un mwy mewn maint. Ond pa un fydd eu Ci Perffaith? Today, the Evans family are joined by two dogs, one small and one larger.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas ishe gwybod pa mor hir yw'r afon a lle mae'n darfod. Felly ma nhw'n dilyn yr afon a gweld amryw bethau ar y daith. The Tralalas ponder the river's length and where it ends.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd. Pan mae o'n tasgu ei sudd oren, mae'n disgwyl i'r tywel hud lanhnau'r llanast. A magic towel always clears up mess. But only if you sing to it!

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae'n ddiwrnod hyfryd ac mae'r Harbwr Feistr yn penderfynu tanio ei fan hufen iâ, Mistar Rhewllyd. It's a lovely day so the Harbour Master fires up his ice cream van. But it needs oil!

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae hedyn o'r gofod yn glanio'n ddamweiniol yn fferm Ffermwr Ffred,ac mae Blero'n awyddus i helpu. A copycat space seed crash lands on Ffarmwr Ffred's farm,and Blero is keen to help.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae Kim a Cêt yn dod o hyd i Twrch yn ei gartre' bach clyd o dan y ddaear. Kim and Cêt find Twrch in his cosy little house underground.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Blwi a Bingo'n dadlau dros y seiloffon hud,sydd â phwerau i rewi Dad a chael rheolaeth llwyr drosto. Blwi and Bingo squabble over the magic xylophone, that has the power to freeze Dad.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Joni eisiau datgelu mai fo yw Jetboi er mwyn creu argraff ar fachgen cwl. Joni wants to reveal that he is Jetboy in order to impress a cool boy.

programme.title: New: A i Y Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Llythyren heddiw yw Ff: 'ff' am 'fforio'. Today's letter is Ff: ''ff' for 'fforio' (foraging).

programme.title: New: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae Tad-cu yn darganfod mai ef yw'r person hynaf ym Mhorthoer- ac mae'n bell o fod yn hapus! Tad-cu finds out he's the oldest person in Porthoer - and he isn't happy about it!

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Cadi Ceffylau a Cai Caffi'n mwynhau diwrnod i ffwrdd o'r gwaith ac yn mynd i rwyfo ar y llyn. Cadi Ceffylau and Cai Caffi are enjoying a day away from work and go rowing on the lake.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Cân draddodiadol am jac-y-do anarferol iawn a'i ffrindiau. A traditional Welsh nursery song about a very unusual jackdaw and his friends.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Pan mae Eli'n codi moronen, mae hi'n siomedig ei bod yn gam. Ond a yw bod yn gam yn eu hatal rhag bod yn flasus? When Ellie digs up a carrot, she's disappointed to discover it's all wonky!

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Byddwn yn teithio i Baris i ddysgu am Pierre Lallement, y dyn wnaeth greu'r beic gyda phedalau nol yn 1863. We learn how bikes work and about the different types, such as motorbikes.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen'n denu Mr Cadno gyda'r addewid y bydd yn cael ei goroni'n "Frenin y Coedwigoedd"! Guto lures Mr Cadno with the promise that he will be crowned "King of the Woods'!

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Ifor Hael sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! The challenge is to collect as many clean teeth as possible and win the Dani Dant Trophy!

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Newyddion i blant hyd at 6 oed fydd yn diddannu ac yn eu dysgu am y byd o'u cwmpas, yn ei holl amrywiaeth. News for children up to 6 years old, to entertain and educate them about the world.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae yna gwml rhyfedd iawn wedi cyrraedd y nen sy'n gwneud i bawb disian. Tybed beth yw e? A strange cloud is making everyone sneeze.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harri yn cael galwad i ddweud bod cwch wedi torri yng Nglan Llyn. Yno hefyd mae Tomi wedi cicio pêl i'r llyn! Harri gets a call to say that a boat has broken down in Glan Llyn.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: A fydd defaid Jacson yn difetha gwyl flodau Preston cyn i Mojo a Bo eu corlannu? Jackson's sheep will ruin Preston's flower festival unless Mojo and Bo can round them up!

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Bela wrth ei bodd yn garddio ac yn falch tu hwnt o'i blodau lliwgar. Pan aiff rhai ar goll, mae'n gwybod pwy sydd ar fai - Anni! Bella's colourful flowers go missing - who's to blame?

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas yn enwi pob anifail sy'n byw yn yr anialwch, ond allwch chi enwi'r planhigyn pigog sy'n tyfu mewn lle poeth a sych fel hyn? The Tralalas explore the hot and dry desert.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd a heddiw mae'n mynd ar ei wyliau. Flying is fun, but the airport is a bit overwhelming. The animals help Pablo work out exactly what he must do.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae 'Rhen Gerwyn yn mwynhau sôn am ei anturiaethau ar y môr ac yn codi ofn ar Twt wrth sôn am fwystfilod môr. Twt doesn't believe in sea monsters but will he change his mind?

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae brêc fflôt carnifal Maer Oci wedi torri.Mae Blero a'i ffrindiau'n trio dal y fflôt. The breaks on Mayor Oci's carnival float have broken.and Blero tries to stop the runaway float.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae ein stori ni'n dechrau yn y goedwig. Tra'n mynd am dro, mae Kim a Cêt yn dod o hyd i Twrch. Our story begins in the forest. While going for a walk, Kim and Cêt find Twrch.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Mam yn mynd i barti 'baby shower' felly Dad sy'n gyfrifol am y merched heno. When Mum goes out for the evening,Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine.

programme.title: Joni Jet
